root_idea.summary: A root principle of movement forward or causing movement, especially through the action of the foot or leg.
root_idea.development: The root extends from striking or impelling with the foot to running and fleeing, and further to related movements such as wing-flapping, fetal motion, agitation, and propulsion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form رَكَضَ rather than the inflected QAC lemma.

senses.definition: To strike or tread the ground with the foot.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic command, the subject is instructed to use his foot against the ground.

senses.definition: To run away, flee, or retreat.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passages, the verb describes flight from a threatened place or punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or move something with the foot or leg; of an animal, to strike a person, and of a person or animal, to kick the ground or a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes physical striking and kicking constructions beyond the Quranic foot-striking command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to move the wings in flight; also, to fly swiftly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to the movement of the wings or to the bird's speed in flight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impel or urge a riding animal forward by striking it with the foot or leg.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively of urging a horse or other riding animal, whether or not it actually proceeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run or move along; of a horse, to run, and of stars, to move across the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of a person's going along by both legs together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiomatic construction, to defend oneself or respond angrily to an affront.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited negative expression means not to defend oneself or become vexed at a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To propel an arrow with a bow; hence, to shoot with a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The bow may be the grammatical subject as the propelling instrument, or the shooter may be the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stir a fire with a fire-stirring tool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tool-based application of striking or agitating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with another in a race, each urging his horse to run.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III reciprocal usage involving a racing contest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a pregnant female, for the fetus to become large and move about in the womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of a woman, mare, or she-camel; the supplied Lane form is normalized from an inflected Form IV occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To race one another by urging one's horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal usage, especially in a racecourse or pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To struggle or convulse with the legs, especially before death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom describing a person struggling with or convulsing in the legs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become in a state of commotion or agitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a fetus moving in the womb or of water in a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become agitated, disturbed, or disquieted in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with فِي and an affair or matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To maneuver, exercise ingenuity, and strive to accomplish an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing active efforts to bring a matter to completion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel through or traverse countries or regions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal-noun usage referring to traversing territory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An impulse, thrust, or sudden motion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the cited traditional expression, it is an impulse attributed to the devil and understood as a دفعَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bow, forceful or rapid propulsion of an arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a bow that sends or impels its arrow swiftly or vehemently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Running, of a horse or mare; moving along, of stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description of a runner or of stars in motion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular proud, self-conceited gait with an affected swaying of the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form has orthographic variants in the lexical sources; the meaning is a distinctive manner of walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part of a horse's flank struck by the rider's heel or foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually used in the plural for the corresponding parts on either side.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A side of a watering-trough against which the water strikes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually used in the plural for the sides of the trough.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare or she-camel whose fetus moves about in her belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participial noun for a pregnant animal showing fetal movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument used for stirring a fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Instrumental noun; the corresponding entry is cross-referenced from another form of the same noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mare that beats the ground with her legs when she runs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun for a running mare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular part of a bow, especially one of its curved extremities or sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote either of the two corresponding parts and has a plural form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place in which water collects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A locative expression referring to a water-collecting place.

The printed Lane citation attached to the foot-striking Quranic expression is not used as a modern verse location; the example 38:42 is anchored by the independently supplied QAC occurrence.
